overall.assessment: Reject confidence routing and phrase-pool blend as universal defaults: catastrophic sunglasses loss plus weak rich-short scope. Keep clause-boundary repair and anti-compensation as mechanisms worth refining; anti improves long-tense affect and restores rich-long anchors, but material short-wealth and gritty-long weaknesses remain. Field centrality remains strongest object/driver mechanism. No global winner.
surviving_mechanisms: Prose centrality for concrete subject matter
Bounded anti-compensation for mood and distributed evidence
